_readme: Feature verification list. Set browser or mac to true only after actually walking through the steps yourself; do not edit or remove steps to make them pass. browser = in a browser (npm run test:e2e or the web trial page); mac = the Mac app built from this repo, on a real Mac. e2e names the automated test file, if any. Earlier sessions recorded many browser checks in VALIDATION.md; walk a feature again before setting it true here.

features.description: Customer list shows companies with main contact, country, owner
steps: Load docs/samples/lai-sample-customers.json
Open 客户 → 客户列表
4 rows, main contact column shows names

features.description: Search by company name narrows the list
steps: Type Lumen in 请输入, press Enter
Only Lumen Lash Lab remains
Clear the box: all rows return

features.description: Clicking a company opens 客户详情 with its contacts
steps: Click Maple & Moss Cosmetics
客户详情 shows Owen Fraser and owen@maplemoss.example

features.description: New customer form saves to the database and survives a reload
steps: 新建客户 → name, country 美国, source 官网, contact, email, phone
确 定
Reload: the customer is in the list

features.description: Edit company and contacts; unknown old fields are kept
steps: Open a customer → 编辑
Change website and a contact phone, save
Reload: changes kept, nothing else lost

features.description: Write a follow-up; it shows in 动态 and updates last-follow-up dates
steps: Open a customer → 动态
Write a follow-up, save
List and detail show the new date

features.description: Create a condition segment and a manual group; counts match the list
steps: 客群 → new segment with a country rule
Count equals the filtered list

features.description: Move to 公海 and back; 客户查重 finds same email/phone
steps: Move a customer to 公海客户, restore it
Create two customers with one email; 客户查重 lists them

features.description: Merge customers, manage tags, bulk create, pool rules
steps: Merge two sample customers
Rename a tag in 标签管理

features.description: 常用: hidden heart on hover marks an entry; the 常用 flyout lists it; survives reload
steps: Hover 公海客户 in the sub-nav: heart appears
Click it: heart fills and stays
Reload: still favorite; 常用 flyout lists it

features.description: Create, edit, filter, page, archive and restore orders
steps: 交易 → 全部订单 → 新建订单
Filter by stage and currency
Archive, then restore

features.description: Workbench numbers match orders, follow-ups and tasks
steps: Create one order and one task
工作台 counts change accordingly

features.description: Calendar month switch, day select, create/edit/complete tasks
steps: Open the calendar, switch month
Create a task, mark it done

features.description: Stats by month, currency and stage; drafts excluded
steps: Create two orders in different currencies
Totals per currency are correct

features.description: Opportunity board: create, move stages, win/lose, link to customer
steps: 商机 → 新建
Drag to the next stage
Mark as won

features.description: Custom sales flows and stages
steps: Settings → 销售流程 → add a stage
New opportunities use it

features.description: Team data reports, targets and team wall
steps: 团队数据 → set a monthly target
Completion updates after an order

features.description: Bind a Zoho mailbox with an app-specific password
steps: 邮件 → 绑定邮箱
Enter address and app password
Verification succeeds; password not shown again

features.description: Receive, read, reply, send with attachment, drafts
steps: Open the inbox, read a mail
Reply with an attachment
Draft is kept after reload

features.description: Switch colour template between 小满, pink and orange
steps: 设置 → 外观 → 粉色
Whole app recolours; text stays readable

features.description: 设置中心 lists every setting and opens the real page
steps: 设置 → 设置中心
Each item opens its page

features.description: Manual backup and restart keep all data
steps: Settings → 备份
Quit and reopen: data unchanged

features.description: Every date and month field opens one Chinese calendar (week starts on Monday) instead of the system control
steps: 交易 → 新建订单: click the date field, a calendar with 周一…周日 opens
Click 今天: the field shows today as YYYY-MM-DD
商机 toolbar: pick a start date, the board filters without an error
协同 → 日历: the month field opens a month picker

features.description: 客户设置: add, rename and delete 客户阶段 / 客户类型; they feed the customer editor and a name in use cannot be deleted
steps: 客户 → 客户设置 → 客户阶段: add 试样中
编辑 a customer: 客户阶段 offers 试样中; save
Delete 试样中: refused, '1 位客户在用'
Rename it: the customer's stage changes and a history line is added
客户类型: pick one in the editor; it shows on 客户详情

features.description: 客户设置: two-level 客户分组 usable in the customer editor, renamed along with customers, protected from deletion while in use
steps: 客户设置 → 客户分组 → 新建分组 重点客户, 添加子分组 A类
编辑 a customer: 客户分组 offers '重点客户 / A类'
Rename 重点客户: the customer shows 核心客户 / A类
Delete A类: refused while the customer is in it

features.description: 客户设置: 建档黑名单 blocks new emails on a customer (whole address or @domain) and rejects bad entries
steps: 客户设置 → 建档黑名单: add @blocked.example; 'not an email' is refused
编辑 a customer, set email to someone@blocked.example: the form says it is in the blacklist

features.description: 客户设置: 客户上限 stops adding customers to a full owner (batch create shows the reason)
steps: 客户设置 → 客户上限: default limit = the owner's current count; the owner row shows 已满
批量建档 a customer for that owner: skipped with '上限是 …'

features.description: 客户设置: 客户查重 display fields and 布局设置 are saved; the layout reaches 客户详情
steps: 客户设置 → 客户查重: tick 跟进人, save
客户设置 → 布局设置: 左大右小
打开 a customer: the detail columns use the left-large layout

features.description: Every dropdown is the same custom control (search box from 9 options, wide enough for the longest option)
steps: Open 客户列表, 订单, 商机 and 设置: no system dropdown appears
Open a dropdown with 9 or more options: a search box is at the top
The chosen option shows in the brand colour with ✓
Switch theme to pink and orange: dropdowns follow the theme

features.description: Left rail entries never overlap the refresh button at any window height
steps: Window 1440×900: all 13 entries and 刷新 are visible, nothing overlaps
Make the window short: the entries scroll, 刷新 stays at the bottom

features.description: Order numbers are never cut off; other cut-off text shows its full text on hover
steps: 交易 → 全部订单: order numbers are shown in full
Hover a long company name that ends with …: the full name appears

features.description: 客户设置 → 公海管理: several auto-move rules (no contact / no deal, groups, start date), daily auto-run, reminders, whitelist, claim limits, hidden pool contacts, move reasons
steps: 客户设置 → 公海管理 → 新建规则: start date defaults to today
立即执行 moves a due customer into 公海客户 with a 公海规则 line in its 动态
公海客户 → 领回客户: pick the 跟进人; 原跟进人 block and 领取上限 refuse with a message
Move a customer to the pool with a required reason

features.description: 客户设置 → 客户跟进规则 / 客户成交规则: which actions count as 最近联系 / 最近跟进; deals by orders or won opportunities; detail page shows 最近成交时间
steps: 客户跟进规则: unchecking every box shows an error; saving changes 最近联系 in the list
客户成交规则: switch to 按商机 and back

features.description: 客户设置 → 写跟进设置 and 动态设置: back-dated follow-ups, follow-up templates (选择模板 in 写跟进 and 批量写跟进), auto-recording mail with customer contacts
steps: Add a template group and text, then 客户详情 → 写跟进 → 选择模板 inserts it
Allow past times: 写跟进 shows 跟进时间; a future time is refused
动态设置: switch on; mail after that moment is recorded once (needs a real mailbox: Mac only)

features.description: 线索: list with status tabs, new/edit, 写跟进, mark invalid, convert to a new customer or link an existing one, trash/restore/delete
steps: Open 线索 in the left rail
Add a lead, write a follow-up (status becomes 跟进中)
Convert it to a customer (country required)
Trash and restore it, reload

features.description: 客户设置: 判重设置 chooses per field whether a repeat is allowed, blocked or ignored; blocked repeats stop the save and name the other customer
steps: 客户设置 → 判重设置: set 邮箱 to 判重，不允许保存 and save
编辑 a customer and enter another customer's email: save is refused naming that customer

features.description: 客户设置: 来源设置 keeps a two-level 来源 list that feeds the customer editor and lead forms; hidden entries disappear from the dropdown
steps: 客户设置 → 来源设置: add 常规获客, add 子来源 展会
编辑 a customer: 客户来源 offers '常规获客 / 展会' only
隐藏 展会: it leaves the dropdown

features.description: 产品: a product list under 交易 with 产品分组 (two levels), 产品字段 (show / required per field) and 规格管理 (types and values); products use them and in-use groups or specs cannot be deleted
steps: 交易 → 产品 → 产品分组: add 睫毛, add 子分组 单根
规格管理: add 颜色, add 规格值 黑色
产品字段: tick 产品型号 必填, untick 产品备注 显示
产品列表 → 新建产品: name, group, spec; saving without 型号 is refused; 备注 is not in the form
删除 a group or spec value that a product uses: refused

features.description: 单据模板: 交易 → 单据模板 has 报价单, 形式发票, 销售订单, 发货通知 tabs (title, columns, terms, footer, bank and signature switches, live preview, print) and a shared 公司信息 tab
steps: 交易 → 单据模板 → 公司信息: fill 公司名称 and 开户银行, save
形式发票: change title to PI 单, untick 单价 and 金额, save: preview follows, reload keeps it
报价单: preview shows the company name; with products in 产品, the table shows them
恢复默认 needs two clicks and brings the default title back
features.description: 商机详情抽屉、附件（上传、列表、删除）、卡片拖动
steps: Open 商机, 新建商机 (pick a customer and contact)
Click the card name to open the detail drawer
Attach a file, see it listed, reload, delete it

features.description: 订单选产品: the order form picks products from 产品 (qty, price, amount = items total, 产品 text follows) and makes a 报价单 / 形式发票 / 销售订单 / 发货通知 preview from the form, with print
steps: Add two products in 产品 (one with 离岸价)
交易 → 新建订单: 添加产品 twice, pick both, type quantity, type the price of the one without 离岸价: amount = total, read-only
点 报价单: preview shows company, customer, both rows, total; change a quantity: preview follows
保存订单; reopen it: items are back; 形式发票 preview shows the order number
Remove all items: amount is typed again
